label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Here's a draft. It's written to be pasted straight into WhatsApp or an email, so there's no fancy formatting.

---

**Subject: I'm safe, and here's what's going on**

Hi everyone,

If you're reading this, you've probably sent me a message in the last few days, and I haven't answered it. I'm sorry. I've read every single one, and I've cried at most of them, but I can't reply to everyone one by one and I'm so tired. So here's one letter for all of you. Please feel free to forward it to anyone who's asking.

**First, the important bit: I'm okay.**
I'm safe, my cat Marmalade is safe, and I'm staying at my sister's in Rondebosch, where I'm being fed and bossed around.

**What happened**
On Saturday night (7 November) at around 11:40pm, a fire started in a ground floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Observatory. I'm on the second floor, in flat 12. All 14 flats got out. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation at Groote Schuur and were sent home the same night, which I'm so grateful for.

The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess or speculate, and I'd ask you not to either.

I'm not going to go through the whole night, because I don't want to relive it. But I do have to tell you about Uncle Faizel from our floor, who banged on every door in his vest and slippers. That's how I woke up. I will be thinking about that for the rest of my life.

I grabbed my phone and Marmalade, and that's all I got out with. Marmalade hid under a car for two hours afterwards and wouldn't come out for anyone. She's fine now, just offended.

My flat has smoke and water damage everywhere, and the ceiling came down in the lounge. My landlord says nobody can move back in for at least six weeks. Honestly, furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can't. I keep reminding myself of that.

**The fundraiser**
My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me, and I'll be honest, I feel weird about it. I hate asking for help. Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it, so I'm accepting it.

It's here: backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court

The target is R25 000, and it was at R11 400 when I last looked. I still can't quite believe that. It's mainly going towards the deposit on a new place, since I can't stay at my sister's forever (she'd say I can, but she doesn't have to live with Marmalade's opinions about her couch).

**Please read this part carefully**
There is a second "fund" going around, and it is **not mine**. It's a page called "Thandi Fire Relief" on a different website, and there's also a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. That is not me, I have nothing to do with it, and I've reported it.

The only fundraiser I'm running is Zinhle's BackaBuddy page above. I will never ask anyone to send money to a bank account over WhatsApp. If you get a message like that, please don't pay it, and please don't forward it. If you've already sent money to it, I'm so sorry, and please contact your bank as soon as you can. And if you're ever not sure whether something is really from me, just ask me or Zinhle.

**What I actually need**
People keep asking, so here's a proper list:

- Help with the deposit for a new place (that's what the fundraiser is for)
- Work shoes in a size 6 and work clothes in a size 34
- A laptop, if anyone has an old one lying around that still works. All of my lesson planning was on mine, and I'm starting from scratch

**What I don't need**
This is going to sound ungrateful, and I promise it isn't:

- More clothes in general. I have so many already, and I'm passing the extras on to the other families from the building, who lost things too
- Food. My sister's freezer is completely full, and I think she may need a bigger freezer

If you've already sent clothes or food, thank you, truly, and please don't feel bad. It all gets used, one way or another.

**For the Little Acorns families**
I teach the Ladybirds (Grade 00) at Little Acorns in Mowbray, and I know a lot of you have been in touch, so some things I want you to know.

The end of year concert on 27 November is still happening. Please don't worry about it. The Ladybirds will have their crowns. (The 22 crowns I'd made at home and the kids' handprint banner did go in the fire, so we're remaking them, and I'm secretly looking forward to doing the handprints again.)

I'm back at school on Wednesday. I'd really appreciate it if nobody made a big thing of it in front of the children. They don't need to see their teacher get emotional at drop-off. They just need me to be Miss Thandi, same as always. If you want to say something to me, a quiet word or a message is perfect.

And to the mom who dropped off a bag of clothes at my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday and left without knocking: I know who you are, and I'm still thinking about it. Thank you.

**Last thing**
Please be patient with me. I'll answer comments slowly, and I may not get to your DMs at all. Please don't be offended if I don't. It isn't because I don't care. It's because I'm reading everything, getting emotional about it, and then putting my phone down to go and have a cry in my sister's spare room.

People have been amazing. I mean that. I don't have the words, and I'm running out of tissues, but I wanted you all to know it.

With so much love and thanks,

Thandi

---

Two things to check before you send it:

- **"Back at school on Wednesday":** today is Wednesday 11 Nov, so if you mean next week, you may want to write "Wednesday 18 November" so it doesn't confuse anyone.
- **Sizes:** I wrote "work shoes size 6" and "work clothes size 34" from your notes. If 34 is for trousers or a skirt specifically, change it so people don't guess.

I left the Capitec account details out of the scam warning on purpose, so the number doesn't get spread further. If you'd rather people could recognise it, I can add them.
